notes.title: Willy Morgan, the patch 1.2.1 fixes an annoying bug!
notes.notes:
Bone Town adventurers,

we have just released the patch "v.1.2.1", immediately available for download, which fixes a specific bug encountered by some users.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/a621f8f30daccb6a67a494279966786d0a3b10ac.jpg

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now available!
notes.notes:
Bone Town adventurers beware, we released Willy Morgan patch 1.2  today which introduces the following new features:


 Added the D-pad functionality in the main menu, in the game menu and in the choice of answers for the gamepad.
 Introduced localization in Brazilian Portuguese and Traditional Chinese.

Note: with the v.1.2 update, partial controller support and related functions are active only if the Xbox configurator and the like is disabled. If the Xbox configurator is active you will not be able to use your gamepad correctly in game.

To disable the Xbox configurator, go to Steam> Settings> Controllers> General Settings and remove the relevant tick. With the v.1.2 update the developer recommended configuration for the Gamepad is no longer available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/629eeb831c9416429847c73520e5870a23ef7727.png

We will resolve this issue as soon as possible, thanks.

notes.title: Willy Morgan - Patch 1.1 is now available!
notes.notes:
As we previously announced, we have some news related to Willy Morgan. Patch 1.1 is now available, introducing the following new features:


 Minor bug fixes.
 Corrections on translations/dubbing
 Added autosave functionality
 Added the "Text background" functionality in the "Options" menu
 Added partial controller support
 Credits added to the game's main menu


Thanks for the support. Stay tuned for other news!

notes.title: Willy Morgan Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Ahoy Adventurers!

So many of you have been asking for a release date and… well, now we can finally reveal it!

Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town will launch on August 11, 2020! 

To celebrate the release, the game will have a 15% discount for a whole week!
